name: support-routing
description: Customer-support ticket routing — auto-classify incoming tickets to billing / tech / sales / cancellation queues.
use_case: Reduce time-to-first-response by routing tickets to the right team automatically.

classes.name: billing
examples: I was charged twice this month for the subscription
Where can I find my invoice from last month?
My credit card was rejected during checkout
How do I update my payment method?
I need a refund for an unused subscription period
The recurring payment failed and my account is suspended
Why did the price increase without notice?
I want to switch from monthly to annual billing
